# T-4: Publish preset helpers

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose shared preset helpers through public container APIs instead of internal preset paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `pathMatch.*` helpers are registered in the container public surface.
- Plugin fixture DataSources can use helpers through `container.get(...)`.
- No plugin-facing source imports helpers from `src/presets/lib`.

## Implementation Notes
Relocate or re-export helper implementation outside non-base preset content while keeping import paths generic.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests for R6 public helper availability and static import checks.
